verdict.rationale: Cortex Analyst lets business users ask questions in natural language and get direct answers without writing SQL, and it is exposed via REST API and the managed MCP server. Semantic Views store business metrics, entities and their relationships in the database, which is the grounding layer the story asks for. However, the pack never explicitly ties Analyst answers to Semantic Views or to RBAC governance, so those links are only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Cortex Analyst answers are grounded in Semantic Views and enforce RBAC, evidence of accuracy or protection against hallucinated joins, independent or hands-on corroboration.
